verdict.rationale: Tavily ships an official hosted MCP server that exposes its search, extract, crawl, map and research tools to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code or any MCP client, plus Agent Skills installed for coding agents. That makes it a ready-made agent tool. However, the evidence never documents explicit function-calling schemas or integrations with agent frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404. missing for 10: documented function-calling/tool schemas, first-party agent-framework integrations, independent hands-on corroboration of tool-call use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the API into an agent as a ready-made tool, with function-calling schemas and agent-framework integrations designed for direct tool-call consumption

citations.quote: Connect Tavily's search, extract, crawl, map, and research tools to Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, Kiro, VS Code, or any MCP client.
claude mcp add tavily --transport http https://mcp.tavily.com/mcp/
Installing the CLI also installs Agent Skills for coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex
